# sudhanva CLI source and Homebrew tap

> Official source, npm package, and Homebrew distribution for the public
> sudhanva.me command-line interface.

## Install

- npm command: `npm install --global sudhanva`
- Command: `brew install nsudhanva/sudhanva/sudhanva`
- Formula: https://github.com/nsudhanva/homebrew-sudhanva/blob/main/Formula/sudhanva.rb
- CLI source: https://github.com/nsudhanva/homebrew-sudhanva/blob/main/cli/sudhanva.mjs
- Release verification: https://github.com/nsudhanva/homebrew-sudhanva/blob/main/scripts/verify-release.mjs

## Contracts

- CLI documentation: https://sudhanva.me/developers/cli/
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/sudhanva
- API documentation: https://sudhanva.me/docs/
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://sudhanva.me/openapi.json
- Profile-insights API: https://sudhanva.me/docs/profile-insights/
- Versioned archive: https://sudhanva.me/cli/sudhanva-0.1.5.tgz
- License: MIT

The CLI requires no credentials and emits JSON. Retrieval commands use HTTPS
GET. The insight command creates and polls a 24-hour, idempotent job using only
published site evidence. Formula changes are checked with Homebrew test-bot.
